name: COMP_000
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (73%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Invasive · Careful review
Normal stays in the 90% conformal set; 4 of 5 similar cases are Normal [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 73%, Normal 25% | Leads, not decisive |
| Conformal set | Normal, Invasive | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.92 / 76th percentile | Input looks typical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Invasive | Neighbors mostly Normal [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 4) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept-model association with invasive carcinoma [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood; spot check 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · Score high, but failed spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 4, 5, 8) · ↑ invasive · Weaker association with invasive carcinoma · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing its top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown faithful. This case leans on Unreliable mitoses and normal lobules.

## Could be wrong if
- The true class is Normal: four of five similar cases are Normal.
- Mitotic and normal-lobule scores are artifacts; both failed the AI spot check (0/20).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 4:** confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
2. **Regions 2, 10, 11:** decide whether these are normal lobules or benign tissue.
3. **Regions 4, 5, 8:** assess pleomorphism and count mitoses directly.
